tempvoice.label: Temporary voice channels
tempvoice.description: Joining a generator channel creates a personal voice channel, deleted when empty.

command.panel: Re-post the control panel in your channel.
command.claim: Become the channel owner if the current one left.
command.transferMember: The member who will receive ownership.
command.notInVoice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel.
command.notTemp: ❌ This channel is not a temporary channel.
command.claimed: 👑 You are now the channel owner.

control.title: Channel settings
control.intro: This is the configuration space for your temporary voice channel. The available options let you customize the channel's permissions to your liking.
control.tip: 💡 Whitelisted members are not impacted by permissions denied to members.
control.desc_open: The channel will be open to all members, except those on the blacklist.
control.desc_closed: The channel stays visible to everyone, but only the whitelist can join.
control.desc_private: The channel will only be visible and joinable by whitelisted members.
control.desc_whitelist: Members and roles in this list can always join the channel.
control.desc_blacklist: Members in this list can never join the channel.
control.desc_purge: Disconnect every member of the voice channel except those covered by the whitelist.
control.desc_transfer: Transfer channel management to a member of your choice.
control.desc_settings: Change the channel's name and member limit.
control.desc_media: Allow or cut members' mic, camera and soundboard. ⚠️ No effect on administrators and the server owner (Discord limitation).
control.notTemp: ❌ This channel is not a temporary channel.
control.notOwner: ⛔ Only the channel owner can do that.
control.ownerPresent: ❌ The owner is still here, you cannot claim the channel.
control.notInChannel: ❌ You must be in the channel to claim it.
control.transferAbsent: ❌ That member must be in the channel to receive ownership.
control.saved: 💾 Settings saved: they will be reapplied to your next channel.

showControlPanel.label: Show the control panel in the created channels
showControlPanel.help: When their channel is created, the member gets a button panel to rename it, lock it, restrict access or change its size. Off, the channel is created bare: the member has no way to adjust it themselves any more, everything goes through staff.

g1.label: 🔊 Hubs (creator channels)
g1.description: Joining a hub automatically creates a temporary voice channel.

hubs.label: Hubs
hubs.help: One row per generator channel: joining it creates a temporary channel and moves the member into it; the channel vanishes as soon as it empties. The generator itself always stays empty, which is expected. The bot needs « Manage Channels » and « Move Members », otherwise the member is left stuck in the generator with no explanation.
